runtime: Linux Perl with Fcntl, Digest::SHA, JSON::PP, Cwd, Time::HiRes, IO::Handle and GNU stat; no Python or Node in image required
rootPrecondition: Existing canonical Linux volume directory, effective and real UID501, directory UID501 GID20 mode0700; no root/chown/chmod performed by helper
rootTimePolicy: Full nine-field root material participates in the initial three stable samples. Own later leaf/sidecar additions may change directory size/mtime/ctime. Root identity six fields never change. Separate complete namespace inventories remain the caller's responsibility.
leafPattern: [A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,180}, excluding . and ..; no slash, aliases or existing leaf overwrite; .known-files- prefix reserved for authority sidecars
newLeaf: O_EXCL O_NOFOLLOW, UID501 GID20 mode0600, regular file, nlink1, stable FD/path GNU-stat nine strings, exact externally known SHA256 and byte length, fsync file and root directory

write.stdin: Exactly FRAME_BYTES bytes then EOF. Compact ASCII JSON with recursively sorted object keys, optional one final LF; exact frame SHA known to Root before invocation.
write.prewriteChecks: Entire frame schema, all known lengths/hashes/hex and all target absences checked before first target is created. Every target is freshly created; partial failed outputs remain for Root and are never removed or replayed.
write.authorityContents: New metadata-only canonical JSON: frame hash, root six-field identity, all initial admitted leaf nine-field/SHA/bytes commitments and three-sample stability counts. No payloads, hex, environment values, key scalars or configurations are copied into the authority.
write.postwriteChecks: Three consecutive exact full-nine/SHA samples spanning at least two seconds within thirty seconds before first authority; fresh EXCL/fsync authority; all leaf pins and authority nine-field/SHA checked again after publication. No refreshed old admission.

verify.stdinPolicy: Mandatory compact ASCII recursively sorted JSON, optional one final LF, maximum4096 bytes and EOF. authorityMaterial MUST be the original nine strings returned by write and already retained by caller; never a newly sampled authority record.
verify.checks: Authority external SHA/bytes plus exact supplied original nine fields before/after; canonical authority schema and root identity; every leaf's original nine fields and known SHA/bytes; distinct leaf inodes. No writes, no stability resampling or metadata refresh. Original stability counts are returned unchanged.

read.stdout: Only the exact payload bytes, after full buffered FD/path/UID/GID/mode/nlink/SHA/length checks. Root must require command exit0 AND expected SHA/length; stdout is private, never published.
read.scope: Byte-pinned stable read of a leaf. It is not a replacement for verify or an existing original-nine-field admission.

receiptValues.filesWritten: write:N; verify:0, excluding the separate new authority sidecar
receiptValues.filesVerified: N payload leaves, excluding authority sidecar (which is separately checked)
receiptValues.payloadBytes: Sum of N payload leaf lengths, excludes authority
receiptValues.stabilitySpanMs: Original integer>=2000 and<=30000, unchanged by verify

configurationScope: A /config upload contains exactly the six expected public payload leaves plus this one explicitly named metadata-only sidecar. The host public directory remains exactly six public files. No environment/key/capsule upload to /config is authorized by this helper.
callerRequirements: Pin helper source SHA/bytes before any private fixture generation or consumption.
Keep source host full-nine/SHA guards before and after preparing/transmitting known frames.
Run helper only in explicitly owned existing immutable-image containers; no network, UID501:20, dropped capabilities and bounded container cleanup.
Keep write/verify receipt including original authorityMaterial private and immutable; use that original record for every later verify.
Never publish read output, raw frames, authorities, inventories or private tool logs. Public output is a filtered fixed scoped count/hash summary.
Check all subprocess exit codes. A timeout or refused operation does not authorize recreating or rebasing a consumed fixture.
A successful helper is transport/ownership evidence, not Nano runtime, slashing, duties, finality, recovery or production qualification.
stat9Wire: GNU stat output must have exactly one terminal LF. Remove it by explicit regex independent of local $/; reject any remaining CR/LF before returning nine strings. Every material component, including ctime, is newline-free.
oldAuthorityPolicy: Do not normalize, migrate or re-admit old v1 material. A v1 material containing LF is not silently converted to v2. Earlier passed opaque helper probes retain their limited scope; failed runtime trials and reservation records remain failed and preserved.
